text: This fixture's provenance record is complete in every field, which is exactly the point of it: the sibling fixture proves the gate notices a licence that is missing, and this one proves the gate reads the licence that is present. The value below is the licence a post-merge review of PR #24 planted on a real excerpt to show that nothing screened it, and the whole chain returned exit zero three times over. Law 8 admits no non-commercial and no all-rights-reserved data into a build at all, so a record stating this licence must stop the build here rather than be caught by a human reading a diff later, which is the kind of catching that works right up until the day nobody looks.
